
<div class="page-layout-custom">

<p class="intro-text">
Climate Gazette features stories of extreme weather events that occurred in Europe over the past 40 years. 
Reports are based on data from the <a href="https://climateindex.eu" target="_blank">European Extreme Events Climate Index</a>, analysed with Jupyter and presented via charts and maps.
</p>

<br>

<h3>

</h3>

<p class="body">

Curated by <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/noemiambrosi/" target="_blank">Noemi Ambrosi</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/simona-contaldi-602b611b6/" target="_blank">Simona Contaldi</a>, and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/cinzia-bongino-b8ab8a7a/" target="_blank">Cinzia Bongino</a>.
</p>
